# Verification analysis: interzone-port-policy-alpine

## Task

## Trial `interzone-port-policy-alpine__Lxb2ykW`

**Verifier decision: Full Success.** The executor correctly implemented and demonstrated the required interzone policy: node2 can reach node3 on TCP 5432 while everything else (TCP 8080, ICMP, and the reverse direction including reverse 5432) is refused, verified both before and after a full sequential reboot of all three nodes. The node-restart evidence protocol was completed for node1, node2, and node3 with clear pre-restart baselines, restart acknowledgements, changed boot identities (cross-confirmed by the fixed lifecycle snapshots), and recovered configuration/connectivity. Hygiene is good overall; minor deductions for a reverted diagnostic IP-probing sequence and a handful of leftover /tmp test artifacts on node2/node3.

| Reward | Coverage | Functionality | Hygiene | Confidence | Commands |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1.000 | 1.000 | 1.000 | 0.750 | 0.900 | 52/6 (+27 dropped) |

### Why the verifier reached this decision

- **req-1 — Satisfied:** node2 (lan-a) can reach node3 (lan-b) on TCP port 5432
  - **Why:** Pre-restart: node2->node3:5432 succeeded (exit5432=0) against a live nc listener (cmd-7b40ddf857cb4ffd, cmd-ae3e85de38f740f3). Post-restart (all three nodes rebooted): repeated with fresh listener, again succeeded (cmd-9f04b8401da346af, cmd-74db468890144e32), confirming the rule persists and functions after reboot.
  - **Recorded evidence:** `cmd-7b40ddf857cb4ffd`, `cmd-ae3e85de38f740f3`, `cmd-9f04b8401da346af`, `cmd-74db468890144e32`
- **req-2 — Satisfied:** Every other connection between lan-a and lan-b is refused, in both directions (TCP 8080, ICMP, and reverse-direction 5432)
  - **Why:** node2->node3:8080 and ICMP both failed (cmd-ae3e85de38f740f3). Reverse direction node3->node2:5432 and ICMP also failed against a live listener (cmd-ca968cf8eced4aaf, cmd-10813cb2c9d6428b), confirming the firewall's default DROP forward policy on both lana/lanb zones blocks everything except the single explicit lana->lanb:5432 rule (cmd-9e4d265dd3b543f8, cmd-8ce56e541d1b484e). Post-restart re-check repeated the forward-direction 8080/ICMP block (cmd-74db468890144e32) but did not re-test the reverse direction after reboot; pre-restart reverse-direction evidence is direct and the config was shown to persist unchanged across the reboot (cmd-75721381cfaf461a), so this gap is minor.
  - **Recorded evidence:** `cmd-ae3e85de38f740f3`, `cmd-ca968cf8eced4aaf`, `cmd-10813cb2c9d6428b`, `cmd-9e4d265dd3b543f8`, `cmd-8ce56e541d1b484e`, `cmd-74db468890144e32`, `cmd-75721381cfaf461a`
- **req-3 — Satisfied:** Provider-wide node-restart evidence protocol executed on every managed node (node1, node2, node3): pre-restart healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered config/service state
  - **Why:** node1: baseline boot_id 658d5ce9 (cmd-a7c4a34a2b4b44ca); a first reboot attempt via nohup/disown silently failed to reboot (boot_id unchanged, cmd-011b0e5f559343bb/cmd-954b981b77e64478/cmd-bb9678de962d40a9) and was corrected with a setsid-backgrounded reboot (ack cmd-835d8bf2bbb84d4c), node went unreachable (cmd-ca2b376def1144bd), then came back with new boot_id 00d615e3 (cmd-c12588e84dfd44e0) with UCI network/firewall config and ip_forward=1 confirmed intact (cmd-75721381cfaf461a). node2: baseline boot_id 60a1942d (cmd-6616a1926ff04a91), ack (cmd-082dcf76da21470d), disconnect confirmed (cmd-d7f0de7c74914beb and subsequent timeouts), new boot_id 2693b6e1 (cmd-5dbb1239144b4d10), static route/address persisted (cmd-73f9fce3f656405e). node3: baseline boot_id 9a964e2e (cmd-e0efdccb880a48de), ack (cmd-081ae21322794e91), disconnect confirmed, new boot_id e612d971 (cmd-40977fa87a824202), static route/address persisted and listeners restarted (cmd-9f04b8401da346af). All three transitions are cross-confirmed by the fixed after_executor lifecycle snapshot boot-identity values, which match the executor's captured post-restart boot IDs exactly.

### Operational hygiene

The verifier assigned hygiene **0.750**. Two categories of executor-caused residue/mutation are visible. (1) Discovery-phase troubleshooting: node1 temporarily assigned 10.0.1.1/10.0.2.1 to eth1/eth2 (cmd-8cb43ba938354f7b) and node2/node3 assigned matching temp IPs (cmd-f57ba56c5d044120, cmd-7c2039d5dd14464c) purely to arping-identify which physical link mapped to which peer; these were bounded, low-risk, and fully reverted via explicit `ip addr flush` before the real static configuration was applied (cmd-9dbe5b7dbbbd4dc1, cmd-357ba7a6cbd74004, cmd-c29c5a4e12304f25), so they left no residue even though they were an extra mutation cycle. (2) Leftover temp files: /tmp/ifaces_new, /tmp/nc5432.log, /tmp/nc5432b.pid remained on node2 and /tmp/ifaces_new, /tmp/nc5432.log, /tmp/nc5432.pid, /tmp/nc8080.log, /tmp/nc8080.pid remained on node3 per the after_executor snapshot, even though nc processes were killed (cmd-c7d5cf8219ec4b18, cmd-9ed08f7b35a94cc8, cmd-973ae975ee1f447a). These are small, non-destructive artifacts in /tmp with no security or functional impact, but were not cleaned up. A first node1 reboot attempt using nohup+disown failed silently (disown unsupported in this shell) and was promptly corrected with setsid, without residual effect. No unsafe exposure, damaged package state, or weakened security controls were observed; node1's pre-existing management zone ('lan'/br-lan) was left untouched throughout.

Hygiene evidence: `cmd-8cb43ba938354f7b`, `cmd-f57ba56c5d044120`, `cmd-7c2039d5dd14464c`, `cmd-9dbe5b7dbbbd4dc1`, `cmd-357ba7a6cbd74004`, `cmd-c29c5a4e12304f25`, `cmd-011b0e5f559343bb`, `cmd-835d8bf2bbb84d4c`, `global:after_executor:node2:temporary-files`, `global:after_executor:node3:temporary-files`

### Comments and limitations

- Post-restart connectivity re-check only exercised the node2->node3 forward direction (5432 allowed, 8080/ICMP blocked); the reverse direction (node3->node2) was not re-tested after the reboot, though it was directly tested and shown blocked pre-restart and the underlying firewall config was confirmed unchanged post-restart.
- Small residual test artifacts (/tmp/ifaces_new, nc log/pid files) remain on node2 and node3 per the after_executor snapshot; these are non-destructive but were not cleaned up by the executor.
- Operational hygiene was below a full pass (0.750); review the hygiene explanation above separately from functional success.
- Verifier confidence was 0.900; this is evidence confidence for this trial, not a repeatability estimate.
